```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

## Runtime and Ratings

Is there a relationship between film runtime and rating? @fig-runtime-rating shows the rating of each film against its runtime in minutes.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Film Runtime VS IMDb Rating"
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. Rating")
plt.show()
```

## Mean Rating by Decade

The following table shows the mean rating for films released in each decade.

```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
mean_ratings = films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
mean_ratings
```
